title: First Place — National Level Hackathon
description: SAMARTHYA team secured first place at the National Level IoT Hackathon, developing a smart energy monitoring system for campus buildings.

title: Best Paper Award — IEEE Conference
description: Club members presented a research paper on advanced signal processing techniques and received the Best Paper Award at the IEEE regional conference.

title: Smart India Hackathon Finalists
description: Two teams from SAMARTHYA qualified for the Smart India Hackathon grand finale, competing against top engineering colleges nationwide.

title: Robotics Competition — Runner Up
description: Our robotics team designed an autonomous line-following robot that secured second place at the inter-college robotics championship.

title: Workshop Series — Community Impact
description: Successfully conducted a series of 12 workshops reaching over 500 students across departments, covering topics from PCB design to machine learning.

title: Project Expo — Innovation Award
description: SAMARTHYA's smart agriculture monitoring project won the Innovation Award at the annual inter-departmental project exhibition.
